entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into a return for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Alex Chen, order number VF78901. It's about the cycling shoes I bought.
Thank you, Alex. I see the order here. Before we proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's the fit. They just hurt my feet so much. I've tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but after every single ride, I get terrible blisters. I saved up for these and I'm just so sad they didn't work out.

I can absolutely understand your disappointment. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our riders. Thank you for clarifying that for me. Let me just check the policy for your item.
Okay. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, I just... I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work. The holidays are coming up, you know?

I understand completely, Alex. And we really appreciate your loyalty. I see here that you are one of our VIP members. Okay, I've checked the policy, and I have good news. Your purchase is well within the 90-day return window, so I can definitely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I'd be stuck with them. Thank you, thank you.

Of course. It's our pleasure to help. As a thank you for being a VIP member, I've also gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Wow, that's wonderful. You've really made my day, Diana. I appreciate it so much.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
